alt: An email thread from February 10–11, 2026, between a DHCS CMAT Analyst and Nicolas Hernandez regarding Complaint 26-30 and administrative barriers to retrieving a patient ID for Western Pacific Med-Corp in Lancaster.
full_text: RE: [External]Re: Complaint 26-30. Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 7:02 AM. Good morning Nicolas, Thank you for confirming. CMAT Analyst, Licensing and Certification Division/Licensing Branch 2/, Counselor & Medication Assisted Treatment (CMAT) Section, California Department of Health Care Services. From: Nicolas Hernandez Sent: Tuesday, February 10, 2026 9:34 PM To: DHCS Analyst Subject: [External]Re: Complaint 26-30. Thank you for following up. I have made several attempts to locate my Patient ID number for Western Pacific Med-Corp in Lancaster, but I am unable to retrieve it for the following reasons: 1. No Physical Records: I was never provided with take-home bottles, intake paperwork, or a patient ID card during my treatment there. 2. Failed Transfer Records: I went to American Health today to see if they had the number on file. They confirmed they do not have transfer records because Western Pacific delayed the fax, forcing a new intake. 3. Safety Concerns: Due to the hostile nature of my wrongful discharge and the clinic's previous refusal to release my records to me directly, I cannot return to the facility or contact them without risking further conflict. Since I have exhausted my options as a patient, I respectfully request that you locate my file using my full name, DOB, and SSN. On Mon, Feb 9, 2026 at 1:37 PM DHCS Analyst wrote: Hi Nicolas, My name is I am the analyst that was assigned to your complaint. Can you please give me your patient ID number for Western Pacific Med-Corp in Lancaster. Thank you.
summary: An email thread from February 10–11, 2026, between a DHCS CMAT Analyst and Nicolas Hernandez regarding Complaint 26-30 and administrative barriers to retrieving a patient ID for Western Pacific Med-Corp in Lancaster.
